verdict.rationale: The Gmail API has documented REST reference pages listing endpoints such as users.messages/send, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI, Swagger, or equivalent). The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and human-readable reference docs do not count as a spec for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
